examples.text_en: This old law antedates the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 这条古老的法律先于新规定。

examples.text_en: The old story antedates this whole war.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事早于整场战争。

examples.text_en: They still use that antediluvian phone today.
examples.text_zh: 他们如今还在用那部老掉牙的电话。

examples.text_en: His antediluvian idea is hard for us.
examples.text_zh: 他那过时的想法让我们很难接受。

examples.text_en: The pain is in the anterior part of his head.
examples.text_zh: 疼痛位于他头部的前面部分。

examples.text_en: This point is on an anterior page.
examples.text_zh: 这一点在前面的某一页上。

examples.text_en: She read the whole anthology last night.
examples.text_zh: 她昨晚读了整本选集。

examples.text_en: This anthology has a great many old works.
examples.text_zh: 这本选集收录了很多古老的作品。

examples.text_en: The anthropoid would look at us with care.
examples.text_zh: 那只类人猿会小心地看着我们。

examples.text_en: We saw a large anthropoid near the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们在水边看到一只巨大的类人猿。

examples.text_en: The anthropologist will live with these people for a year.
examples.text_zh: 这位人类学家将和这些人一起生活一年。

examples.text_en: A young anthropologist will talk here today.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的人类学家今天将在这里做报告。

examples.text_en: We need an antibiotic for that bad pain.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要一种抗生素来对付那阵剧痛。

examples.text_en: This antibiotic will help the child feel better.
examples.text_zh: 这种抗生素会帮助孩子好起来。

examples.text_en: These antibiotics will help him feel much better.
examples.text_zh: 这些抗生素会帮他感觉好很多。

examples.text_en: We must use antibiotics for this bad pain.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须用抗生素来对付这阵剧痛。

examples.text_en: The body will make an antibody to fight this thing.
examples.text_zh: 身体会制造一种抗体来对抗这种东西。

examples.text_en: One antibody can work against only one bad thing.
examples.text_zh: 一种抗体只能对付一样有害的东西。

examples.text_en: The children did a crazy antic for us.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们为我们做了一个疯狂的滑稽动作。

examples.text_en: Such an antic can make the whole family happy.
examples.text_zh: 这样一个滑稽动作能让全家感到开心。

examples.text_en: The children wait in anticipation of the game.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们期待着这场比赛。

examples.text_en: His anticipation of the news was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 他对这条消息的期待非常强烈。

examples.text_en: There was an anticipatory feel in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里有一种期待的气氛。

examples.text_en: His anticipatory look was a clear sign.
examples.text_zh: 他期待的神情就是一个明显的信号。

examples.text_en: The end of the film was a real anticlimax.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影的结尾真让人大失所望。

examples.text_en: After the big game the party felt like an anticlimax.
examples.text_zh: 大赛之后，这场聚会让人感到虎头蛇尾。

examples.text_en: They found an antidote in the old book.
examples.text_zh: 他们在那本旧书里找到了一种解毒剂。

examples.text_en: There is no antidote for that kind of thing.
examples.text_zh: 对那种东西没有解毒剂。

examples.text_en: This antihistamine will help your bad back pain.
examples.text_zh: 这种抗组胺药会缓解你严重的背痛。

examples.text_en: He will take an antihistamine every morning.
examples.text_zh: 他每天早晨都会吃一片抗组胺药。

examples.text_en: His antipathy for that man was very clear.
examples.text_zh: 他对那个人的反感非常明显。

examples.text_en: She felt a strong antipathy towards the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她对这项计划感到强烈的反感。

examples.text_en: This will antiquate the old way of work.
examples.text_zh: 这会让旧的工作方式变得过时。

examples.text_en: Time can antiquate even the best thing.
examples.text_zh: 时间甚至能让最好的东西变得陈旧。

examples.text_en: This antiquated system still works quite well.
examples.text_zh: 这套陈旧的系统至今运转得相当好。

examples.text_en: They use an antiquated way to make the books.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一套过时的方法制作这些书。

examples.text_en: The city is known for its great antiquity.
examples.text_zh: 这座城市因其古老而闻名。

examples.text_en: He will study the art of antiquity with care.
examples.text_zh: 他会用心研究古代的艺术。

examples.text_en: She put an antiseptic on the bad cut.
examples.text_zh: 她在伤口上涂了抗菌剂。

examples.text_en: This antiseptic is used for a small cut.
examples.text_zh: 这种抗菌剂用于小伤口。

examples.text_en: His whole life was the antithesis of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他的一生与这项计划截然相反。

examples.text_en: This man is the very antithesis of his brother.
examples.text_zh: 这个人正是他兄弟的对立面。

examples.text_en: The old man hit the anvil with his hand.
examples.text_zh: 老人用手敲着铁砧。

examples.text_en: A big anvil was near the open door.
examples.text_zh: 一个巨大的铁砧放在敞开的门旁。

examples.text_en: The blood must go from the heart to the aorta.
examples.text_zh: 血液必须从心脏流到主动脉。

examples.text_en: A small cut in the aorta can be very bad.
examples.text_zh: 主动脉上的小伤口可能非常危险。

examples.text_en: We saw a big ape at the city park.
examples.text_zh: 我们在城市公园看到一只大猿。

examples.text_en: The ape will hold a small ball in its hand.
examples.text_zh: 那只猿会用一只手拿着小球。

examples.text_en: We look through a small aperture in the wall.
examples.text_zh: 我们透过墙上的小孔看。

examples.text_en: The aperture will let in a lot of light.
examples.text_zh: 这个孔会让大量光线进来。

examples.text_en: The apes would look at us with care.
examples.text_zh: 那些猿会小心地看着我们。

examples.text_en: We saw two apes near the old house.
examples.text_zh: 我们在那栋老房子附近看到两只猿。

examples.text_en: We were at the apex of the long road.
examples.text_zh: 我们处在长长道路的最高处。

examples.text_en: His career was at its very apex then.
examples.text_zh: 那时他的事业正处于顶峰。

examples.text_en: He put a short aphorism on the first page.
examples.text_zh: 他在第一页写了一条简短的格言。

examples.text_en: This old aphorism still has a lot of truth.
examples.text_zh: 这句古老的格言仍然很有道理。

examples.text_en: The old man will keep an apiary near his home.
examples.text_zh: 老人将在自家附近办一个养蜂场。

examples.text_en: We saw a large apiary at the far end.
examples.text_zh: 我们在远处看到一个大养蜂场。

examples.text_en: She will take the bad news with real aplomb.
examples.text_zh: 她会非常镇定地接受这个坏消息。

examples.text_en: He will say it with great aplomb.
examples.text_zh: 他会非常沉着地说出这件事。

examples.text_en: The film will show an apocalyptic world after the war.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影将展现战后一个末日般的世界。

examples.text_en: His words had an apocalyptic feel that night.
examples.text_zh: 那晚他的话语带着一种末日般的气息。

examples.text_en: This old story is part of the apocrypha.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事属于旁经。

examples.text_en: Many people have never read the apocrypha.
examples.text_zh: 很多人从未读过旁经。

examples.text_en: That story about him is probably apocryphal.
examples.text_zh: 关于他的那个故事很可能是捏造的。

examples.text_en: People tell an apocryphal story about the king.
examples.text_zh: 人们讲述着关于国王的一个不足凭信的故事。

examples.text_en: His power was at its apogee last year.
examples.text_zh: 去年他的权力达到了顶峰。

examples.text_en: The story was at its apogee near the end.
examples.text_zh: 故事接近尾声时达到了高潮。

examples.text_en: The apoplectic man could not move his hand.
examples.text_zh: 那个中风病人无法活动他的手。

examples.text_en: They found the apoplectic near the open door.
examples.text_zh: 他们在敞开的门旁发现了那个中风病人。

examples.text_en: His apostasy from the old group was a big deal.
examples.text_zh: 他脱离旧团体的变节可是件大事。

examples.text_en: The story of his apostasy will become known.
examples.text_zh: 他变节的故事终将为人所知。

examples.text_en: They will call him an apostate after that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天之后他们会称他为叛教者。

examples.text_en: The apostate left the old group for good.
examples.text_zh: 那个变节者永远离开了旧团体。

examples.text_en: You need an apostrophe in that short word.
examples.text_zh: 那个短单词里需要一个撇号。

examples.text_en: She put an apostrophe on the board.
examples.text_zh: 她在黑板上写了一个撇号。

examples.text_en: The apothecary will give him a little box.
examples.text_zh: 药剂师会给他一个小盒子。

examples.text_en: We go to the apothecary near the market.
examples.text_zh: 我们去市场附近的药房。

examples.text_en: This apothegm is short but full of sense.
examples.text_zh: 这条箴言虽短，却充满智慧。

examples.text_en: He will often end his talk with an apothegm.
examples.text_zh: 他常常以一个格言结束讲话。

examples.text_en: The film was the apotheosis of his career.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影是他事业的巅峰。

examples.text_en: They saw him as the apotheosis of the art.
examples.text_zh: 他们把他视为这门艺术的极致。

examples.text_en: The bad news will appal the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息会让全家人大为震惊。

examples.text_en: Such a thing would appal any good man.
examples.text_zh: 这种事会让任何好人感到惊骇。

examples.text_en: That story will appall the young children.
examples.text_zh: 那个故事会吓到年幼的孩子。

examples.text_en: The whole thing would appall most people.
examples.text_zh: 这整件事会让大多数人感到惊骇。

examples.text_en: They used a special apparatus to test the water.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种特殊装置检测水质。

examples.text_en: The apparatus was too big for the small room.
examples.text_zh: 这个装置对这个小房间来说太大了。

examples.text_en: She put on her best apparel for the party.
examples.text_zh: 她为聚会穿上了最好的衣服。

examples.text_en: That company will make apparel for young people.
examples.text_zh: 那家公司将为年轻人制作服装。

examples.text_en: She saw an apparition in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 她在黑暗里看见一个幽灵。

examples.text_en: The old house is full of apparitions.
examples.text_zh: 这座老房子满是幽灵。

examples.text_en: Her story was very appealing to the people.
examples.text_zh: 她的故事对人们很有感染力。

examples.text_en: He will give me an appealing look.
examples.text_zh: 他会用恳求的神情看着我。

examples.text_en: He was trying to appease the old man.
examples.text_zh: 他正努力安抚那位老人。

examples.text_en: This food will appease the children for now.
examples.text_zh: 这些食物暂时能让孩子们安静下来。

examples.text_en: That man had a special appellation for her.
examples.text_zh: 那个人对她有一个特别的称呼。

examples.text_en: This appellation is used for the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 这个名称用于指整个群体。

examples.text_en: The small room is an appendage to the house.
examples.text_zh: 这个小房间是主屋的附属部分。

examples.text_en: This box is just an appendage to the main one.
examples.text_zh: 这个盒子只是主盒的附属物。

examples.text_en: The answer is in the appendix of the book.
examples.text_zh: 答案在这本书的附录里。

examples.text_en: He put the data in an appendix at the end.
examples.text_zh: 他把数据放在末尾的附录里。

examples.text_en: We had a small appetizer before the main food.
examples.text_zh: 主菜之前我们吃了一小份开胃菜。

examples.text_en: This appetizer will make you want more food.
examples.text_zh: 这道开胃菜会让你想吃更多东西。

examples.text_en: The food here is always very appetizing.
examples.text_zh: 这里的食物总是非常开胃。

examples.text_en: It was an appetizing thing for us all.
examples.text_zh: 那对我们大家来说是道可口的菜。

examples.text_en: They will apportion the food among the children.
examples.text_zh: 他们将把食物分给孩子们。

examples.text_en: The old man will apportion his money to each son.
examples.text_zh: 老人将把钱分给每个儿子。

examples.text_en: His words were apposite to the whole question.
examples.text_zh: 他的话对这个问题很贴切。

examples.text_en: That was an apposite answer to a hard question.
examples.text_zh: 那是对一个难题的贴切回答。

examples.text_en: The appraisal of the house will take a day.
examples.text_zh: 对这座房子的估价将花一天时间。

examples.text_en: We need a new appraisal of the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要对整个计划重新估价。

examples.text_en: They will appraise the old house next week.
examples.text_zh: 他们下周将评估这栋老房子。

examples.text_en: We must appraise the cost before we start.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须先估好成本再开始。

examples.text_en: There was an appreciable change in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里有了可察觉的变化。

examples.text_en: The cost was an appreciable part of the total.
examples.text_zh: 这笔费用占了总额中相当可观的一部分。

examples.text_en: The police will apprehend the man very soon.
examples.text_zh: 警察很快就会逮捕那名男子。

examples.text_en: We do not apprehend what he really means.
examples.text_zh: 我们不明白他到底是什么意思。

examples.text_en: His apprehension about the test was very clear.
examples.text_zh: 他对考试的忧虑非常明显。

examples.text_en: The police will make an apprehension near the market.
examples.text_zh: 警方将在市场附近实施逮捕。

examples.text_en: She felt apprehensive about the whole thing.
examples.text_zh: 她对整件事感到惴惴不安。

examples.text_en: The children were apprehensive on the first day.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们第一天感到不安。

examples.text_en: Please apprise us of the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 请把新计划通知我们。

examples.text_en: He will apprise the group of the change.
examples.text_zh: 他会把这一变化通知全组。

examples.text_en: The plan will win the approbation of all.
examples.text_zh: 这项计划将赢得所有人的认可。

examples.text_en: He will say it with a look of approbation.
examples.text_zh: 他会带着认可的神情说出这番话。

examples.text_en: The appropriation for the school was quite large.
examples.text_zh: 给这所学校的拨款相当可观。

examples.text_en: They talk about the appropriation of public money.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论着公共资金的拨用。

examples.text_en: His words were apropos of the whole question.
examples.text_zh: 他的话对这个话题很恰当。

examples.text_en: That was an apropos thing to say just now.
examples.text_zh: 刚才说那句话正合适。

examples.text_en: She aptly put the whole idea into one line.
examples.text_zh: 她恰当地把整个想法写进了一行。

examples.text_en: The name is aptly given to this old place.
examples.text_zh: 这个名字给这个地方起得很恰当。

examples.text_en: She had a box with a small aquamarine.
examples.text_zh: 她有一个装着小块海蓝宝石的盒子。

examples.text_en: The sea was a clear aquamarine that morning.
examples.text_zh: 那天早晨海水是清透的浅绿色。

examples.text_en: This aquatic form can live in deep water.
examples.text_zh: 这种水生生物能生活在深水里。

examples.text_en: We saw an aquatic near the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们在水边看到一种水生生物。

examples.text_en: The old aqueduct will bring water to the city.
examples.text_zh: 古老的引水渠将把水送到城里。

examples.text_en: They will build a long aqueduct across the land.
examples.text_zh: 他们将修建一条横穿大地的长引水渠。

examples.text_en: The water is from a deep aquifer.
examples.text_zh: 这水来自一个很深的含水层。

examples.text_en: They found a large aquifer under the land.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这片土地下发现了一个巨大的含水层。

examples.text_en: The old man had a strong aquiline face.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人有一张鹰似的脸。

examples.text_en: She has an aquiline face and dark hair.
examples.text_zh: 她有一张鹰似的脸和黑发。

examples.text_en: The wall was full of a fine arabesque.
examples.text_zh: 墙上布满了精美的阿拉伯式花饰。

examples.text_en: They saw an old arabesque in the room.
examples.text_zh: 他们在房间里看到一个古老的阿拉伯式花饰。

examples.text_en: The Arabian man will tell us a long story.
examples.text_zh: 那位阿拉伯人将给我们讲一个长故事。

examples.text_en: We read about old Arabian art last week.
examples.text_zh: 我们上周读了关于古老阿拉伯艺术的内容。

examples.text_en: The land here is good and arable.
examples.text_zh: 这里的土地很好，适合耕种。

examples.text_en: They will turn the land into arable ground.
examples.text_zh: 他们要把这片土地变成可耕地。

examples.text_en: The small arachnid can live on the wall.
examples.text_zh: 这种小蛛形动物能生活在墙上。

examples.text_en: We found an arachnid under the old box.
examples.text_zh: 我们在旧盒子下面发现了一只蛛形动物。

examples.text_en: The arbiter will hear both of us today.
examples.text_zh: 仲裁人今天会听取我们双方的意见。

examples.text_en: He was the final arbiter of the whole case.
examples.text_zh: 他是整个案件的最终裁决者。

examples.text_en: They will ask him to arbitrate the case.
examples.text_zh: 他们会请他来仲裁这个案子。

examples.text_en: A good man can arbitrate between two groups.
examples.text_zh: 一个好人能在两个团体之间进行仲裁。

examples.text_en: The two companies will use arbitration.
examples.text_zh: 这两家公司将采用仲裁。

examples.text_en: The arbitration was a long and hard thing.
examples.text_zh: 这场仲裁是件漫长而艰难的事。

examples.text_en: The arbitrator will give a decision soon.
examples.text_zh: 仲裁人很快会作出裁决。

examples.text_en: Each side must trust the arbitrator.
examples.text_zh: 各方都必须信任仲裁人。

examples.text_en: This is an arboreal kind of life.
examples.text_zh: 这是一种栖于树木的生活方式。

examples.text_en: The arboreal life will keep them high above.
examples.text_zh: 树栖生活让它们高居其上。

examples.text_en: We walk through the arboretum each week.
examples.text_zh: 我们每周都穿过树木园散步。

examples.text_en: The old arboretum is full of green life.
examples.text_zh: 这座古老的树木园满是绿色生机。

examples.text_en: The ball will go in a high arc over us.
examples.text_zh: 球会以一道高弧线从我们头顶飞过。

examples.text_en: We saw a clear arc of light.
examples.text_zh: 我们看见一道清晰的光弧。

examples.text_en: His words were arcane and hard to understand.
examples.text_zh: 他的话晦涩难懂。

examples.text_en: The old book is full of arcane sense.
examples.text_zh: 这本旧书满是晦涩难解的意味。

examples.text_en: They found an archaeological site near the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们在镇附近发现了一处考古遗址。

examples.text_en: The archaeological work will take a year.
examples.text_zh: 这项考古工作将耗时一年。

examples.text_en: She will study archaeology at a good university.
examples.text_zh: 她将在一所好大学学习考古学。

examples.text_en: Archaeology can tell us about the old world.
examples.text_zh: 考古学能告诉我们关于古老世界的事。

examples.text_en: This old story is the archetype of them all.
examples.text_zh: 这个古老的故事是它们全体最初的原型。

examples.text_en: He is the very archetype of a good man.
examples.text_zh: 他正是好人的典型。

examples.text_en: The country is a large archipelago.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家是一片广阔的群岛。

examples.text_en: We saw the archipelago from the high ground.
examples.text_zh: 我们从高处望见了那片群岛。

examples.text_en: The old city has great architectural value.
examples.text_zh: 这座古城具有很高的建筑价值。

examples.text_en: We talk about the architectural style of it.
examples.text_zh: 我们谈论它的建筑风格。

examples.text_en: We found an old record in the archives.
examples.text_zh: 我们在档案室里找到一份旧记录。

examples.text_en: The archives hold many old books.
examples.text_zh: 档案室里存放着许多旧书。

examples.text_en: He is an ardent friend of art.
examples.text_zh: 他是艺术的热心朋友。

examples.text_en: She was an ardent support of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她是这项计划的热心支持者。

examples.text_en: He will talk with great ardor about the plan.
examples.text_zh: 他会满怀热情地谈论这项计划。

examples.text_en: Her ardor for the work was very strong.
examples.text_zh: 她对这项工作的热情非常强烈。

examples.text_en: The work was long and very arduous.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作漫长而非常费力。

examples.text_en: They had an arduous walk across the land.
examples.text_zh: 他们进行了一次穿越陆地的艰苦步行。

examples.text_en: The game will be in a large arena.
examples.text_zh: 比赛将在一个大场地举行。

examples.text_en: He will walk into the arena with care.
examples.text_zh: 他会小心翼翼地走进场地。

examples.text_en: They talk in a special argot.
examples.text_zh: 他们用一种特别的行话交谈。

examples.text_en: This old argot is hard for us to understand.
examples.text_zh: 这种旧行话对我们来说很难懂。

examples.text_en: We hear a beautiful aria every night.
examples.text_zh: 我们每晚都能听到一段美妙的咏叹调。

examples.text_en: The aria was the best part of the show.
examples.text_zh: 这段咏叹调是整场演出的最佳部分。

examples.text_en: The aristocracy had great power in that time.
examples.text_zh: 那时贵族拥有很大的权力。

examples.text_en: She was born into the old aristocracy.
examples.text_zh: 她出身于旧贵族。

examples.text_en: A great armada will go across the sea.
examples.text_zh: 一支庞大的舰队将横渡大海。

examples.text_en: The whole armada was lost in the war.
examples.text_zh: 整支舰队在战争中覆没。

examples.text_en: The country used much money for armament.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家把很多钱用于军备。

examples.text_en: They talk about the growth of armament.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论军备的增长。

examples.text_en: They will sign a short armistice soon.
examples.text_zh: 他们很快会签署一份短期停战协议。

examples.text_en: The armistice will bring the long war to an end.
examples.text_zh: 停战将结束这场漫长的战争。

examples.text_en: The old man put on his armor.
examples.text_zh: 老人穿上了他的盔甲。

examples.text_en: This armor will keep him safe in war.
examples.text_zh: 这套盔甲会在战争中保护他。
